name: hcportal_getKennelMessages
description: Portal read of one of a kennel's two chat threads (E9.F1.S33), through HC6.nonApi_getKennelMessages — the app's read — so both follow one set of rules. Token paramString '<deviceSecret>:<publicKennelId>'.

parameters.name: publicKennelId
parameters.description: The kennel, by PUBLIC id (a browser holds public ids only), resolved to the internal id at the door. Unknown/removed: { Success 0, 'Kennel not found' }.

parameters.name: sinceSequenceCount
parameters.description: Delta fetch: only messages with MessageSequenceCount above this. NULL = full fetch, which also performs the bell-on update.

parameters.name: reactionsSince
parameters.description: The last reactionsAsOf this client saw (E9.F1.S22). With it, the ReactionUpdates rowset carries reactions changed since then on messages at or below @sinceSequenceCount. NULL = that rowset is empty.

parameters.name: kennelThread
parameters.description: 0 (default) the kennel's general chat, 1 its private Mismanagement chat (members only: HC6.UserInKennelMismanagement).

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: On any refusal or error: { Success 0, ErrorMessage }.

rowsets.name: Messages
rowsets.description: Live messages of the kennel thread the reader may see, ORDER BY createdAt DESC. Empty when nothing is newer than @sinceSequenceCount.

columns.name: id
columns.description: EventMessage.id, UPPER-cased text (the app lowercases on arrival).

columns.name: canDelete
columns.description: 1 when the caller wrote it or may moderate this kennel's chat (HC6.nonApi_mayModerateChat).

columns.name: replyToMessageId
columns.description: EventMessage.ReplyToMessageId, UPPER-cased; NULL when not a reply (E9.F1.S21).

columns.name: replyToText
columns.description: First 200 characters of the quoted message; NULL when not a reply or the original was removed.

columns.name: replyToRemoved
columns.description: 1 when the quoted message exists but was removed.

rowsets.name: RemovedMessageIds
rowsets.description: Every removed message in the thread (Removed = 1), so a client drops any it already drew — a delta by sequence number never sees a deletion. Find it by column name.

rowsets.name: ReactionUpdates
rowsets.description: ALWAYS present (empty when @reactionsSince is NULL or nothing changed): { id, reactions } for live messages at or below @sinceSequenceCount whose ReactionsUpdatedAt is after @reactionsSince.

rowsets.name: ReactionsAsOf
rowsets.description: One row — the server time to pass back as @reactionsSince.

sideEffects: UPDATE HC.HasherKennelMap SET KennelNotificationPreference = 1 for the caller's non-removed row in this kennel when it is 0 — only on a full fetch (@sinceSequenceCount IS NULL), lines 75-78; the row's updatedAt trigger re-syncs it to the hasher's phones
EXEC HC6.nonApi_mayModerateChat (kennel scope) to decide canDelete, line 81
INSERT HC.ErrorLog on NULL kennelId (line 59) and from the CATCH block (lines 138-140, after ROLLBACK)
breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
